figures.title: This paper in the 13 components, against the field
figures.subtitle: Each box: what this paper does, then common practice across all sensors and how many ledger papers share it.
figures.caption: Verdicts compare the paper's choice for each component with common practice across 8,995 ledger entries on any sensor (silent speech, brain-to-text, lip reading).

choice: No user training action; voiced broadcast speech (LRS2, LRS3, VoxCeleb2)
HuBERT features quantized to 200 k-means units; a memory per unit trained by ASR on 656 h paired audio-text, recalled from video by cross-attention
M02.note: Memory recall is prior work from the same group; 2.0 points over distillation, one run, memory trained on 656 h of transcripts.

choice: AV-HuBERT initialisation (1,759 h unlabelled), fine-tuned; memory built beforehand
Voiced speech, video alone at test
Transformer encoder, two-layer cross-attention bridge (4.7M parameters), Transformer decoder, hybrid CTC/attention
M06.note: Bridge placement is part of M02.

choice: External language model for the proposed rows not stated
M07.field: No language model in reported rows
M07.note: Comparator rows are stated as LM-free; the proposed rows are not.

choice: LRS3 30/433 h and LRS2 28/223 h settings; test partition not named
LRS3 and LRS2 WER, single run, no seeds
M12.note: State-of-the-art claim does not hold against the cited SynthVSR Large row, which trains on more data; the proposed rows' LM use is unstated.

choice: Offline; about 5M added parameters; no latency or compute
